A small, end-to-end open-data project for ingesting Cricsheet match data, building clean CSV tables, and exploring descriptive cricket metrics.

WPL is the initial dataset, not a hard-coded limit: the same parser and analytics functions support any Cricsheet JSON archive whose records conform to the published schema.

**What you get**

- Reusable Python package + scripts for download, parse, and stage-1/stage-2 tables
- Matches, deliveries, batting/bowling summaries, phase summaries, quality report
- Streamlit explorer for matches, scorecards, players, phase scoring, and tables
- Jupyter notebook for deeper exploratory analysis

No ML model is trained yet — the focus is solid ingestion, honest metric definitions, and reproducible tables.

**Stack:** Python, uv, Pandas, Streamlit, Cricsheet data.

Source: [Utkarsh736/open-cricket-analytics](https://github.com/Utkarsh736/open-cricket-analytics).
